ache.title: Six archetypes, and an ‘ultimate’ guide with a season tag
ache.note: Six archetypes, across Memory of Chaos, Apocalyptic Shadow and Pure Fiction. That’s six teams the game would love you to own, and a “Summer 2024” label means this ultimate guide gets replaced next season. The more modes a guide covers, the bigger the shopping list hiding inside it.
watch: six archetypes, six teams to build
three endgame modes to keep up with
ache.tip: Choose one archetype you love playing and let the others go. Not every mode needs a full clear.
lines: six archetypes. you have one life
pick the team that makes you smile

videoData.title: Ultimate Account Build Guide - Summer 2024 | Honkai Star Rail

textData.text: In this essential Honkai Star Rail guide, we'll deep dive into building the perfect account. Learn about the six archetypes crucial for conquering Memory of Chaos and Apocalyptic Shadow, understand team compositions for optimizing Pure Fiction, and discover versatile characters that fit any archetype. We'll explore specific team builds for DPS, support, and healing roles, including hyper carry, skill point-based teams, Super Break, follow-up attack, damage over time, and area of effect archetypes. Tune in to find detailed recommendations and strategies for each archetype and character, ensuring a powerful and enjoyable gaming experience.
